# AION2 KINA

> Independent multilingual AION2 player resource with source-labelled guides, official item records, interactive maps, calculators, and checklists.

Canonical: https://www.aion2kina.com/
Languages: Simplified Chinese (/zh-hans/), Traditional Chinese (/zh-hant/), English (/en/), French (/fr/), German (/de/), Spanish (/es/), Japanese (/ja/), Brazilian Portuguese (/pt-br/), Russian (/ru/), Korean (/ko/)
Publisher: AION2 KINA
Primary site author: PFG
Status: Independent fan resource; not affiliated with or endorsed by NC Corporation.
XML sitemap: https://www.aion2kina.com/sitemap.xml

Equivalent editorial content and localized site navigation are maintained across all ten locale routes listed above. Map points are curated by AION2 KINA, reviewed in game, and checked against NC official information and third-party guide data (Atreia Guide). Official item records are still sourced primarily in Traditional Chinese, English, and Korean; pages disclose the source language and any fallback display when official terminology is unavailable in a locale. Cite the canonical URL for the language used.

## Editorial and citation notes

- Official announcements, official game data, first-party field verification, editorial assessments, and third-party community sources are labelled separately.
- Version-sensitive pages state their service region, source, and review date when available.
- Prefer the visible source links on each page for game facts.
- AION2 KINA does not claim that editorial difficulty ratings, tool calculations, field observations, or third-party community findings are official NC conclusions.
- Corrections can be submitted at https://www.aion2kina.com/en/contact/.
